fields.System.Title: INB-307 — Directed putaway that tops up a low pick face
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want arriving stock sent straight to a pick face that is low,
so that we save a separate replenishment trip for the same units.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a pick face for the product is below its minimum, then the putaway suggestion
  • targets that pick face for the quantity needed.
  • - Given the pick face need is less than the received quantity, then the task splits:
  • part to the pick face, the remainder to bulk.
  • - Given a pick face top-up putaway completes, then any open replenishment task for that
  • location is closed or reduced.
  • - Given the product is expiry-tracked, then the top-up must not place newer stock in
  • front of older stock at the pick face.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, replenishment, inventory |
| Tables | putaway_task, replen_task, stock_balance |
| Risks | Duplicate work with replenishment ([doc 09 §7.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); breaking FEFO at the pick face |
| Tests | unit · integration |
